why: Issue #736: the preview workload's report omits the preview's own renderer settings, so a reader cannot tell what antialias, pixel-ratio cap and shadows the measured frames were drawn with.
killedBy: buildBenchReport reports the preview workload with no session and the preview renderer it measured (issue #736)
createRouteHost: the ?bench=preview workload is page-scoped (issue #736) hands the preview a timing scheduler, and publishes a report of the frames it ran with no session
